name: leetcode-clone
description: A full-stack coding platform similar to LeetCode

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=frontend && npm install --workspace=backend && npm install --workspace=execution-engine
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend" "npm run dev --workspace=execution-engine"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=frontend && npm run build --workspace=backend
